arguments.title: RAFT: Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms for Optical Flow
key_claims: All-pairs correlation and iterative updates offer dense motion estimates; the paper includes a small roughly1M-parameter variant. Flow is useful as a diagnostic for moving background regions or mask consistency, not as unquestioned ground truth. Light flashes, color changes, blank stage areas and cuts may violate its transfer assumptions; this is a LightSem-specific concern, not a result measured by the paper. Include static-image color-change controls and known translations before using flow to veto labels. No first-pilot motion-controller replacement is proposed.
